concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-003 proposes measuring interpretability overlap by computing a Spearman rank‑correlation between GNNExplainer substructure rankings and SHAP descriptor rankings, or by requiring ≥3 of the top‑5 features to overlap. GNNExplainer outputs subgraph masks (i.e., atom‑level or functional‑group substructures), whereas SHAP ranks scalar molecular descriptors. These are fundamentally different feature spaces, so a direct Spearman correlation or top‑k overlap is not a scientifically valid comparison. The metric conflates heterogeneous representations and may produce arbitrary values, undermining the claim of a meaningful interpretability assessment.
